class DigitalClockApp:
    def __init__(self, root):
        self.root = root
        self.root.title("Modern Digital Clock")
        self.root.geometry("500x300")
        self.root.configure(bg='#1e1e2e')
        
        # Make window not resizable but keep it centered
        self.root.resizable(False, False)
        
        # Center the window
        self.center_window()
        
        # Create main frame
        self.main_frame = tk.Frame(root, bg='#1e1e2e')
        self.main_frame.pack(expand=True, fill='both', padx=20, pady=20)
        
        # Time label
        self.time_label = tk.Label(
            self.main_frame,
            font=('Courier', 48, 'bold'),
            fg='#00ffcc',
            bg='#1e1e2e'
        )
        self.time_label.pack(pady=(20, 5))
        
        # Date label
        self.date_label = tk.Label(
            self.main_frame,
            font=('Arial', 16),
            fg='#a0a0c0',
            bg='#1e1e2e'
        )
        self.date_label.pack(pady=(5, 20))
        
        # AM/PM indicator
        self.ampm_label = tk.Label(
            self.main_frame,
            font=('Arial', 14),
            fg='#ff9966',
            bg='#1e1e2e'
        )
        self.ampm_label.pack()
        
        # Theme toggle button
        self.theme_button = tk.Button(
            self.main_frame,
            text="Toggle Theme",
            command=self.toggle_theme,
            bg='#4a4a6a',
            fg='white',
            relief='flat',
            font=('Arial', 10),
            padx=10,
            pady=5
        )
        self.theme_button.pack(pady=(20, 0))
        
        # Store current theme state (0 = dark, 1 = light)
        self.theme_state = 0
        
        # Start the clock
        self.update_time()
    
    def center_window(self):
        self.root.update_idletasks()
        width = self.root.winfo_width()
        height = self.root.winfo_height()
        x = (self.root.winfo_screenwidth() // 2) - (width // 2)
        y = (self.root.winfo_screenheight() // 2) - (height // 2)
        self.root.geometry(f'{width}x{height}+{x}+{y}')
    
    def update_time(self):
        # Get current time
        now = datetime.now()
        current_time = now.strftime("%H:%M:%S")
        current_date = now.strftime("%A, %B %d, %Y")
        
        # Update time display
        self.time_label.config(text=current_time)
        
        # Update date display
        self.date_label.config(text=current_date)
        
        # Update AM/PM indicator
        hour = int(now.strftime("%H"))
        ampm = "AM" if hour < 12 else "PM"
        self.ampm_label.config(text=ampm)
        
        # Schedule next update
        self.root.after(1000, self.update_time)
    
    def toggle_theme(self):
        if self.theme_state == 0:  # Currently dark, switch to light
            self.root.configure(bg='#f0f0f0')
            self.main_frame.configure(bg='#f0f0f0')
            self.time_label.configure(bg='#f0f0f0', fg='#2c3e50')
            self.date_label.configure(bg='#f0f0f0', fg='#7f8c8d')
            self.ampm_label.configure(bg='#f0f0f0', fg='#e74c3c')
            self.theme_button.configure(bg='#bdc3c7', fg='#2c3e50')
            self.theme_state = 1
        else:  # Currently light, switch to dark
            self.root.configure(bg='#1e1e2e')
            self.main_frame.configure(bg='#1e1e2e')
            self.time_label.configure(bg='#1e1e2e', fg='#00ffcc')

            self.theme_button.configure(bg='#4a4a6a', fg='white')
            self.theme_state = 0

if __name__ == "__main__":

        self.root = root

import tkinter as tk
import random

class SnakeGame:
    def __init__(self, root):
        self.root = root
        self.root.title("Snake Game")
        self.root.geometry("500x550")
        self.root.configure(bg='#1e1e2e')
        
        # Game constants
        self.GAME_WIDTH = 400
        self.GAME_HEIGHT = 400
        self.SPEED = 150
        self.SPACE_SIZE = 20
        self.BODY_PARTS = 3
        self.SNAKE_COLOR = "#00ff00"
        self.FOOD_COLOR = "#ff0000"
        self.BACKGROUND_COLOR = "#000000"
        
        # Create game frame
        self.game_frame = tk.Frame(root, bg='#1e1e2e')
        self.game_frame.pack(pady=20)
        
        # Score label
        self.score = 0
        self.score_label = tk.Label(
            self.game_frame,
            text=f"Score: {self.score}",
            font=('Arial', 16, 'bold'),
            bg='#1e1e2e',
            fg='#ffffff'
        )
        self.score_label.pack(pady=5)
        
        # Canvas for game
        self.canvas = tk.Canvas(
            self.game_frame,
            bg=self.BACKGROUND_COLOR,
            height=self.GAME_HEIGHT,
            width=self.GAME_WIDTH,
            highlightthickness=0
        )
        self.canvas.pack(pady=5)
        
        # Controls info
        controls_label = tk.Label(
            self.game_frame,
            text="Use Arrow Keys to Move",
            font=('Arial', 10),
            bg='#1e1e2e',
            fg='#a0a0c0'
        )
        controls_label.pack(pady=2)
        
        # Restart button
        self.restart_button = tk.Button(
            self.game_frame,
            text="Restart Game",
            font=('Arial', 12),
            bg='#4a4a6a',
            fg='white',
            command=self.restart_game
        )
        self.restart_button.pack(pady=10)
        
        # Initialize game variables
        self.direction = 'down'
        self.snake_coordinates = []
        self.snake_squares = []
        self.food_coordinates = []
        
        # Bind arrow keys
        self.root.bind('<Up>', lambda event: self.change_direction('up'))
        self.root.bind('<Down>', lambda event: self.change_direction('down'))
        self.root.bind('<Left>', lambda event: self.change_direction('left'))
        self.root.bind('<Right>', lambda event: self.change_direction('right'))
        
        # Start game
        self.restart_game()
    
    def restart_game(self):
        # Reset game state
        self.score = 0
        self.score_label.config(text=f"Score: {self.score}")
        self.canvas.delete(tk.ALL)
        
        # Reset snake
        self.snake_coordinates = []
        self.snake_squares = []
        
        # Create initial snake
        for i in range(self.BODY_PARTS):
            self.snake_coordinates.append([0, 0])
            
        for x, y in self.snake_coordinates:
            square = self.canvas.create_rectangle(
                x, y, 
                x + self.SPACE_SIZE, 
                y + self.SPACE_SIZE,
                fill=self.SNAKE_COLOR,
                tag="snake"
            )
            self.snake_squares.append(square)
            
        # Create first food
        self.create_food()
        
        # Start game loop
        self.next_turn()
    
    def create_food(self):
        x = random.randint(0, (self.GAME_WIDTH // self.SPACE_SIZE) - 1) * self.SPACE_SIZE
        y = random.randint(0, (self.GAME_HEIGHT // self.SPACE_SIZE) - 1) * self.SPACE_SIZE
        
        self.food_coordinates = [x, y]
        
        self.canvas.create_oval(
            x, y,
            x + self.SPACE_SIZE,
            y + self.SPACE_SIZE,
            fill=self.FOOD_COLOR,
            tag="food"
        )
    
    def next_turn(self):
        x, y = self.snake_coordinates[0]
        
        # Calculate new head position based on direction
        if self.direction == "up":
            y -= self.SPACE_SIZE
        elif self.direction == "down":
            y += self.SPACE_SIZE
        elif self.direction == "left":
            x -= self.SPACE_SIZE
        elif self.direction == "right":
            x += self.SPACE_SIZE
            
        # Add new head
        self.snake_coordinates.insert(0, [x, y])
        square = self.canvas.create_rectangle(
            x, y,
            x + self.SPACE_SIZE,
            y + self.SPACE_SIZE,
            fill=self.SNAKE_COLOR
        )
        self.snake_squares.insert(0, square)
        
        # Check if food is eaten
        if x == self.food_coordinates[0] and y == self.food_coordinates[1]:
            self.score += 1
            self.score_label.config(text=f"Score: {self.score}")
            self.canvas.delete("food")
            self.create_food()
        else:
            # Remove tail if no food eaten
            del self.snake_coordinates[-1]
            self.canvas.delete(self.snake_squares[-1])
            del self.snake_squares[-1]
            
        # Check for collisions
        if self.check_collisions():
            self.game_over()
        else:
            # Continue game
            self.root.after(self.SPEED, self.next_turn)
    
    def change_direction(self, new_direction):
        # Prevent 180-degree turns
        if new_direction == 'left' and self.direction != 'right':
            self.direction = new_direction
        elif new_direction == 'right' and self.direction != 'left':
            self.direction = new_direction
        elif new_direction == 'up' and self.direction != 'down':
            self.direction = new_direction
        elif new_direction == 'down' and self.direction != 'up':
            self.direction = new_direction
    
    def check_collisions(self):
        x, y = self.snake_coordinates[0]
        
        # Check wall collision
        if x < 0 or x >= self.GAME_WIDTH or y < 0 or y >= self.GAME_HEIGHT:
            return True
            
        # Check self collision
        for body_part in self.snake_coordinates[1:]:
            if x == body_part[0] and y == body_part[1]:
                return True
                
        return False
    
    def game_over(self):
        self.canvas.delete(tk.ALL)
        self.canvas.create_text(
            self.GAME_WIDTH/2,
            self.GAME_HEIGHT/2 - 20,
            font=('Arial', 24, 'bold'),
            text="GAME OVER",
            fill="red",
            tag="gameover"
        )
        self.canvas.create_text(
            self.GAME_WIDTH/2,
            self.GAME_HEIGHT/2 + 20,
            font=('Arial', 16),
            text=f"Final Score: {self.score}",
            fill="white",
            tag="gameover"
        )

if __name__ == "__main__":
    root = tk.Tk()
    game = SnakeGame(root)
    root.mainloop()
